science_card_focus: Inspect only the source-reported incompressible kinetic energy E_i at equilibration versus quench duration tau_Q for the two simulated temperature branches T=10^-6 and T=1, including the fitted power laws, uncertainty, realization counts, weighted-least-squares convention, and any explicitly source-supported common tau_Q domain.
